title: Daily SGS Top 5
tagline: Five stories, one question: who's in control?

stories.headline: Paraguay's president quits after a digital bank freezes millions of savings
stories.summary: Paraguay's president quit after a digital bank froze savings for about three million people. Congress refused the resignation so a Senate trial can strip immunity.
stories.label: Slightly Sovereign
stories.why: People and lawmakers force accountability after a connected lender locked everyday money.
stories.what_it_means: People and lawmakers are forcing accountability after a connected lender locked everyday money.
stories.economic_impact: Families can't pay for food, and bonds fell.
stories.everyday_example: It's like the credit union freezing every card after the mayor's friends ran the books.

stories.headline: Türkiye ratifies a Mecca defense pact with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: Turkish lawmakers ratified the Mecca defense pact with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia. An attack on one counts as an attack on all.
stories.label: Moderately Sovereign
stories.why: Three regional powers write their own defense rules instead of waiting for NATO or the UN.
stories.what_it_means: Three regional powers are writing their own defense rules instead of waiting for NATO or the UN.
stories.economic_impact: Arms and logistics ties may deepen.
stories.everyday_example: It's like three neighbors signing a shared alarm instead of calling a distant HOA.

stories.headline: Putin meets Iran's security chief on "no foreign" Gulf security
stories.summary: At the Kremlin, Putin met Iran's security chief, who brought a message from Iran's supreme leader. Talks covered Gulf security with no outside countries, and a Russia-to-Iran gas pipeline.
stories.label: Moderately Globalist
stories.why: Moscow and Tehran sketch who runs Gulf security after the fighting.
stories.what_it_means: Moscow and Tehran are sketching who runs Gulf security after the fighting.
stories.economic_impact: A gas link would deepen energy dependency.
stories.everyday_example: It's like two landlords redrawing the rules while tenants aren't in the room.

stories.headline: US sanctions hit Cuban oil networks, tankers and Chinese suppliers
stories.summary: The State Department sanctioned Cuban oil networks, tankers, and Chinese firms tied to military parts shipped through Cuba.
stories.label: Moderately Sovereign
stories.why: Washington turns Donroe talk into paperwork in America's near abroad.
stories.what_it_means: Washington is turning Donroe talk into paperwork in America's near abroad.
stories.economic_impact: Cuban tankers lose US access while ordinary Cubans already face blackouts.
stories.everyday_example: It's like a neighborhood watch locking the alley after outside crews stocked a hostile warehouse.

stories.headline: Trump teases a Europe-wide deal after meeting Putin's envoy
stories.summary: After meeting Putin's envoy, Trump teased a big, beautiful deal that might involve all of Europe, not just Ukraine. Deal terms are still undisclosed.
stories.label: Strongly Globalist
stories.why: Two capitals float a security map while Ukraine and most of Europe aren't at that table yet.
stories.what_it_means: Two capitals are floating a security map while Ukraine and most of Europe aren't at that table yet.
stories.economic_impact: Markets will price ceasefire odds and winter energy risk.
stories.everyday_example: It's like two landlords redrawing the lease for the whole building.
